intended_object: There isn't one. The docstring calls it part of a "checked nominal proof certificate" (`nb095_alpha_dummy_123`). It picks a fresh dummy variable that avoids the free variables of the class variable `cv (nb095AlphaDummy112 D R S_cls E)`, for use in alpha-renaming inside a generated proof.
explanation: The definition is `freshVar (fv ∪ fv) 0`: it returns a variable that does not occur among the free variables of another auxiliary term. Note that the same set is unioned with itself. This is the kind of bookkeeping that machine-generated proof-certificate code does when it renames bound variables, and its name ("AlphaDummy123") says the same. It does not formalize any concept from the mathematical literature. So it is an implementation detail, not a mathematical object.
